title: Names of his parents, brother and uncle Phil Markley
summary: Woods supplies the names of his parents, brother and namesake uncle.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Hey Phil, just for the record, we didn’t get the name of your parents and your brother, just for the record.
Oh yes, my mother’s name was Clara, Clara, Clara Mary Markley Woods and my father was Stanley Joseph and my brother was Stanley Joseph, Jr. and uh my namesake uncle was Phil Markley,
who was a representative up in Boston. uh He was a politician, good man. He was he and my dad had a business together, and were very close.
Were you lucky enough to have your parents around for a long time?
